newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Equitable Life stg bond A plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Equitable Life stg bond A plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had assigned Equitable Life Finance Plc's 350 million stg subordinated debt issue a rating of A plus.
"The rating is based on a guarantee by the parent company the Equitable Life Assurance Society (ELAS) which has a financial strength rating of AA," S&P said in a statement.

"The rating of ELAS is based on its leadership of the UK pensions market, a position which the company is well placed to maintain given its superior expense control and efficient operations," the agency said.
"The company has acceptable capitalisation supported by strong bonus disciplines. Financial flexibility is however, considered limited but has been improved by the subordinated debt issue."
S&P said it expected continued growth in new business and market share based on ELAS's very competitive products, potentially improving maturity values and targeted marketing.
"Over the long term, S&P believes ELAS's product mix may change in response to market demands but that the Society will remain a leading player in the UK life and pensions market," S&P said.
"Capitalisation is likely to be good but will be largely a function of the maturity of the book of business."
